name: Cloudflare AI Gateway
description: Proxies requests to OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Workers AI, and other model providers, adding analytics, logging, caching, rate limiting, and retries with model fallback.

skills.name: Analytics
skills.description: Shows metrics such as request counts, tokens, and the cost of running your application.

skills.name: Logging
skills.description: Records requests and errors passing through the gateway for inspection.

skills.name: Caching
skills.description: Serves repeat requests from Cloudflare's cache instead of the model provider to cut latency and cost.

skills.name: Rate Limiting
skills.description: Limits the number of requests your application receives to control how it scales.

skills.name: Request Retry and Fallback
skills.description: Retries failed requests and falls back to other models when a provider returns an error.
